How often (proposal)

  • About 1 day in 7 shows an egg; the other days show the plain board.
  • Picked by the date, like boardVariantIndex in Header.tsx: FNV-1a over the local "YYYY-MM-DD". Egg day when h % 7 == 0; which egg = floor(h / 7) % 8.
  • Same on every screen and device that day; changes at the person's own midnight; never animated.
  • Native bundles 8 eggs x ~116 KB = ~0.93 MB extra (or load the egg tile only on an egg day on web).
